articles.title: What's New in iOS 27.2 Beta 1
articles.description: Apple has released iOS 27.2 beta 1 to developers, bringing a redesigned Health app, five additional Siri AI languages, Apple TV profiles on iPhone and iPad, new CarPlay Ultra themes, and more. Here's a look at everything we've found in the first beta so far. The redesigned Health app is organized into three tabs: Insights, Longevity, and Browse. Insights surfaces recent and relevant data such as vitals, sleep score, heart rate, and Activity Rings, while Longevity shows health data over time and provides a Health Age calculated from activity level, VO2 max, sleep time, and other metrics. The feature also includes in-app assessments that use the iPhone's camera to measure flexibility, strength, balance, and VO2 max. The new app is limited to U.S. English for now and also carries a new icon. articles.title: What AI means for the fate of mathematics
articles.description: NEW YORK, United States — OpenAI has rattled the quiet world of mathematics by using artificial intelligence to solve a major, century-old problem, raising the question of what role mathematicians will play in scientific research going forward. Earlier this month, thousands of its AI agents worked together to solve the Navier-Stokes equations — which generations of mathematicians have tried to tackle — in a matter of four days. UCLA professor Terence Tao, who has won the elite Fields Medal recognizing the world’s most esteemed mathematicians, told AFP: “I am currently completely overwhelmed with an existential crisis in my field.” READ: The [...]... Keep on reading: What AI means for the fate of mathematics

articles.title: Morning Mail: AI tipping point warning; concerns about aged care scheme; and a US rate hike
articles.description: Want to get this in your inbox every weekday? Sign up for the Morning Mail here , and finish your day with our Politics, really newsletter . Morning everyone.
